title: A pack of ME audio files anywhere?

posts.author: firestalker
posts.body:
Resource Type:
Musical Effects, Audio
Maker Format:
MV, any sound file. I can convert
Makers I Own:
MV
Art Style:
Fantasy-themed, stuff that will match an RPG game well
Description:
I'm looking for more Musical Effects [ME] files. I have found a ton of BGM, SE, and BGS files... but the ME has been sparse. And the ones that come with MV are good, but they are few and I would like to have a little more variety when I go to add sound to my events.

posts.author: firestalker
posts.body: Bump...  And I'm not looking for any specific music, just looking for a database or site that has them so I can find what I need when I need it.

posts.author: Acinder
posts.body: I've been using an AI program called suno.ai to create BGM. That may can be used to create little 20s-60s jingles as well

posts.author: Acinder
posts.body:
Today I found myself in need of musical effects as well but neither suno or udio did well with that. They both seem to work AMAZINGLY for generating customized music (especially with the extend feature), but not small jingles.
I ended up using elevenlabs AI. A tool I use to create voice acting sometimes. It has a sound effects generator that did a good job. I was able to make quite a few useful effects for it (not the ones in the vid though, those are okay.. haha):
Maybe this will be of help to you as well and if you need any help with it, just ask
